project.name: DITAP workshop: accessible case management
project.need: A fictional federal team wants to replace a fragmented case management process without excluding people with disabilities.
project.users: Members of the public and agency staff who use assistive technology, mobile devices, and low-bandwidth connections.
project.constraints: Illustrative exercise only. Do not use this as market research evidence or as a supplier shortlist.

accessibility_requirements.notes: The fictional workshop has not yet identified Section 508 requirements.
